patch_list: HBO Max - Block SSAI Ad Origins

Reproduces the AdGuard DNS ad-block inside the app: fails media3 segment requests to HBO's SSAI ad origins (amer-free/emea-free.prd.media.max.com, gmss, FreeWheel) so the player's resiliency layer falls back to the clean, ad-free manifest…

Suppresses nonlinear overlay ads (Bolt), SSAI linear ad timeline registration (GMSS/AdSparx), and live stream preroll ad timeline entry generation for all content types. Best paired with 'Remove Ad Periods (keep 5.1)': on its own, suppress…
Adds a remote-navigable on-screen speed control (0.5x–2.0x) to the HBO Max player. Opt-in; touches no DRM, ad, or network code. Not device-verified yet.

Loads HBO's own ad-free FALLBACK manifest instead of the ad-stitched PRIMARY one by remapping the stream selection in getStreamInfo (only when a FALLBACK stream exists). Ad-free on fresh start and resume with no markers, no timeline gaps,…

Keeps the normal PRIMARY stream (with 5.1 / E-AC-3 audio) but removes the stitched ad periods from its DASH manifest before playback. Overrides 'Prefer Ad-Free Stream' (its stereo-only fallback remap is switched off automatically). Fail-op…

sources.label: Morphe patches for mobile phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and more.
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.

Reports video as decodable at every size and frame rate, so the app can request the highest rendition. Experimental: can stutter or fail on a device that cannot decode it. Pair with Video quality set to 2160p.
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Keeps Sign in with Google turned off. The Android TV app has no such option, so this does nothing there.
Blocks HBO Max's ad servers, so videos play without ads.
Plays the video resolution you choose instead of letting the app pick one. Videos can buffer if your connection is too slow for it.
